summary: validate_argument_spec returns argument_errors and argument_spec_data on failure, plus validate_args_context.
questions: How do I see which arguments failed validation?

answer_card.title: validate_argument_spec return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `argument_errors` (failure): list of errors
- `argument_spec_data` (failure)
- `validate_args_context`: where it was called
